name: Tinker: Build: Spider Bomb chases the build target (#5291)
contract: Build: Spider Bomb 500535 summons creature 226012 (AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp:130, 15 s duration) whose device AI only chases after SetGUID(1) (Summons.cpp:303-305 MoveChase) and otherwise sits where spawned. The retarget broadcast in OnSpellCast ran only under NotifySpellAttack, which rejects positive-family spells (Tinker.cpp NotifySpellAttack: family 34 + IsPositive gate), and Build spells never set the focus there — so a bomb built with no prior attack had no target and stood still. The broadcast now also fires for Build(info) casts with a valid attack target. The discriminator is the bomb-to-enemy distance shrinking after the build, mirroring the knockback distance shape.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Build a Spider Bomb on the enemy with no prior attack
CONTRACT: the bomb closed distance to the enemy
